feature: Local reversible PII substitution for outgoing school reports

scope.school_queue_and_http_payload: Automatically substitutes known identities and detected PII before queueing and sending; migrates legacy pending records before transmission.
scope.response_restoration: Local prepare/restore interface with a per-request token allow-list. Never exposed as a model-facing MCP tool.
scope.secrets: Irreversibly removed; originals are not retained in the restoration table.
scope.vault: Local plaintext file, private POSIX permissions and atomic cross-process transactions. Not transmitted or bundled.
scope.native_model_chat: Not intercepted by a skill. Requires client integration before model networking and after response receipt.
scope.free_text: Pattern and dictionary detection does not guarantee discovery of every personal detail.
scope.existing_server_records: Unchanged; no retrospective database cleanup performed.

note: The parallel desktop release retained the tested privacy implementation and superseded the initial privacy-only deployment. Current live checksums were verified without reverting the desktop release.
